description_en: Creates a Virtual Storage Channel (VSC) for an ECS instance
description_zh: 为ECS实例创建虚拟存储通道
kebab_example: aliyun ecs create-vsc --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-bp00c262 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVsc

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call DescribeRegions to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The tag key of instances, cloud disks, and primary ENIs that are created by using the template version. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. The tag key cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 通过该模板的版本创建的实例、云盘和主网卡的标签键。N 的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以 aliyun 和 acs:开头，不能包含 http://或 https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the command. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
命令的标签值。N的取值范围为1~20。该值可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The ID of the enterprise resource group to which the resource belongs
parameters.help_zh: 资源所在的企业资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the Virtual Storage Channel
parameters.name: vsc_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the Virtual Storage Channel
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The VSC type. Valid values: Primary and Standard. Default value: Primary
parameters.name: vsc_type

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。更多信息，请参见如何保证幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values: true: sends a check request without querying resource status. The check items include whether the AccessKey pair is valid, whether the Resource Access Management (RAM) user has the required authorization, and whether the required parameters are specified. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the DryRunOperation error code is returned. false: sends a Normal request. If the request passes the check, a 2XX HTTP status code is returned and the resource status is queried. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否只预检此次请求。取值范围： true：发送检查请求，不会查询资源状况。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码DryRunOperation。 false：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2XX HTTP状态码并直接查询资源状况。默认值：false
parameters.name: dry_run

VscId.description_en: The ID of the Virtual Storage Channel
